title: Deviations
intro: Where the plan and the linked Jira items disagree. Astrolabe only reads from Jira: nothing is written back, corrections are made in the plan.

sources.title: Data from Jira
sources.refreshFailed: The refresh could not be started
sources.refreshInvalid: This connection cannot be refreshed (it is disabled or gone)
sources.running: A refresh is running. This page updates by itself.
sources.noteNever: No refresh has finished yet: the figures are as they were when each item was linked.
sources.noteFailed: The last refresh failed: {{error}}. The figures may be out of date.
sources.noteInterrupted: The last refresh did not finish. The figures may be out of date.
sources.noteAbandoned: The last refresh was abandoned. The figures may be out of date.
sources.noteDisabled: The connection is disabled: its items are not refreshed and show what was last read.
sources.noteMapping: The mapping does not fit the site now (or the connection was never tested): levels and estimates are not compared for its items. An administrator can fix it on the connection page.

totals.truncated: Only the first {{count}} items are listed. The warning and info counts cover every match; narrow the filters to see the rest.
totals.openOnly: The warning, info and gone figures count open items only, whatever the list shows.

filter.showAllHint: Also list items without a deviation and estimates that cannot be compared

phrase.goneOutOfScope: No longer readable in Jira: deleted, moved out of the connection's projects, or no longer visible to its account
phrase.goneForbidden: No longer visible to the connection's account
phrase.levelMismatch: The Jira item is at hierarchy level {{jira}}, but the mapping expects level {{plan}} here
phrase.levelMismatchUnknown: The Jira item's hierarchy level is unknown, but the mapping expects level {{plan}} here
phrase.levelMismatchBare: The Jira item is at a different hierarchy level than the mapping expects
phrase.parentMismatch: Its parent in Jira is {{jira}}, but in the plan it sits under {{plan}}
phrase.parentMismatchJira: Its parent in Jira is {{jira}}, which is linked to another plan item
phrase.renamed: Named “{{jira}}” in Jira and “{{plan}}” in the plan
phrase.startLater_one: Starts {{count}} working day later than Jira
phrase.startLater_other: Starts {{count}} working days later than Jira
phrase.startEarlier_one: Starts {{count}} working day earlier than Jira
phrase.startEarlier_other: Starts {{count}} working days earlier than Jira
phrase.startDiffers: Starts on a different day than in Jira
phrase.endLater_one: Ends {{count}} working day later than Jira
phrase.endLater_other: Ends {{count}} working days later than Jira
phrase.endEarlier_one: Ends {{count}} working day earlier than Jira
phrase.endEarlier_other: Ends {{count}} working days earlier than Jira
phrase.endDiffers: Ends on a different day than in Jira
phrase.targetDiffers: The target window differs from Jira's project dates
phrase.unscheduledInPlan: Jira has dates, but the plan item is not scheduled
phrase.unscheduledInJira: The plan item is scheduled, but the Jira item has no dates
phrase.estimateDiffers: Estimate is {{plan}} man-days in the plan and {{jira}} man-days in Jira
phrase.estimateNotComparable: Jira's estimate of {{jira}} {{unit}} cannot be compared with the plan's {{plan}} man-days
phrase.estimateNotComparableBare: Jira's estimate of {{jira}} cannot be compared with the plan's {{plan}} man-days
phrase.progressDone: Done in Jira, but the plan ends on {{plan}}
phrase.progressTodo: Not started in Jira, but the plan started on {{plan}}
phrase.progressInProgress: In progress in Jira, but the plan starts on {{plan}}
phrase.progressBare: The Jira status does not fit the plan's dates
